description: Delete one finished Backsies backup of a hosted website, and its copies in extra destinations, to free space. It disappears from the list at once; the data is removed during the next backup. Cannot be undone. Confirm required. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

domain.description: Site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id. Pass this or domain.

name: oma_backsies_delete
title: Delete a website backup
